brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether regional implementation of shared care with respect to type 2 diabetes is feasible, effective and cost-effective.
brief_title: Development, Implementation and Evaluation of a Complex Regional Intervention for Type 2 Diabetes: Diabetes Project Aalst

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All type 2 diabetes patients living in the defined intervention region
* All caregivers involved in type 2 diabetes care in the defined intervention region

Exclusion Criteria:

* None

official_title: Development, Implementation and Evaluation of a Complex Regional Intervention for Type 2 Diabetes.

primary_outcomes.time_frame: Longitudinal analysis on measurements from 01/01/2004 until 31/12/2006
